tournaments.name: Nitro Christmas ❄️
tournaments.description: Welcome to the Nitro Christmas tournament, hosted to celebrate the holiday season and the arrival of winter. Created to highlight outstanding Nitro Type teams and bring racers together, this competition features a total prize pool of 10M to 20M NT Cash distributed among the top finishers. Prepare your team, sharpen your typing skills, and join us for an exciting winter celebration.
tournaments.format: 64 players  ·  Scored by Races  ·  Min 10 races in each round to qualify

tournaments.name: IMT Ally Celebration Tournament
tournaments.description: Join for a chance to win up to 10M NTC!!! Captains pay their own team members if they want to.
